## Summary

Describe the user problem and the resulting behavior.

## Implementation

Explain important decisions, migrations, compatibility effects, and failure handling.

## Validation

List the exact commands and results used to verify the change.

## Checklist

- [ ] I added or updated tests for the behavior and failure paths.
- [ ] I preserved existing migrations and historical domain behavior.
- [ ] I kept new and substantially modified files below 500 lines.
- [ ] I updated user, operations, or contributor documentation where needed.
- [ ] I included no secrets, private records, databases, backups, exports, or generated production configuration.
- [ ] Installation, deployment, migration, backup/restore, security, networking, or persistent-data changes have an RC validation plan.
